relation_definitions.CAUSES: Changing A brings about B under explicitly stated held-fixed background conditions.
relation_definitions.DEPENDS_ON: A requires B under the stated rules; query direction is explicit.
relation_definitions.ENABLES: A supplies a required condition or removes a barrier; another stated trigger is needed for B.
relation_definitions.INHIBITS: A prevents or reduces B under otherwise matched conditions.
relation_definitions.SUPPORTS: A provides evidence for proposition B.
